output.explanation: A site row is only held to account when its status is ACTIVE: in that case it must have an activated_on date. Rows with any other status, or no status, pass automatically.
fails_when: status is exactly "ACTIVE" and activated_on is null (missing)
Comparison is case-sensitive, so "active" or "Active" is not treated as ACTIVE and passes without needing activated_on
Other columns (site_id, site_name, country, enrolment_target, updated_at) are not checked; the activated_on date is not checked for being in the past or any range, only for being present
passes_when: status is null (missing), whatever activated_on holds
status is anything other than exactly "ACTIVE" (e.g. "PENDING", "CLOSED", or lowercase "active"), whatever activated_on holds
status is exactly "ACTIVE" and activated_on has a date value
